results.title: Controlling Contact-Rich Manipulation Under Partial Observability
results.abstract: Addresses contact-rich manipulation with uncertainty in object state and dynamics using a particle-filter belief compressed as a Gaussian mixture and a set of goal-directed controllers whose switching policy is learned for real-time closed-loop execution.

results.title: Tactile-Filter: Interactive Tactile Perception for Part Mating
results.abstract: Uses a particle-filter estimate of uncertain part pose and selects interactive tactile actions for uncertainty reduction before and during high-precision part mating.

results.title: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
results.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33
results.abstract: Defines value-equivalent models by requiring agreement only on the Bellman updates relevant to a selected policy and value-function set, allowing simpler models that preserve planning consequences without reconstructing all environment dynamics.

results.title: Deciding What to Model: Value-Equivalent Sampling for Reinforcement Learning
results.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35
results.abstract: Frames approximate value-equivalent modeling as lossy compression under a rate-distortion objective and relates the retained model information to downstream decision regret.

results.title: Smart Predict, then Optimize
results.abstract: Introduces the SPO loss, which evaluates prediction errors through the downstream optimization objective and constraints, and a tractable surrogate that learns predictions for decision quality rather than generic prediction accuracy.

results.title: Constrained Variable Impedance Control using Quadratic Programming
results.venue: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

results.title: Unified force-impedance control
results.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
results.abstract: Develops a passivity-based framework that unifies force and impedance behavior using an energy tank so that interaction objectives are mediated by explicit energetic feasibility.

results.title: Optimization-Based Variable Impedance Control of Robotic Manipulator for Medical Contact Tasks
results.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

results.title: A predictive safety filter for learning-based control of constrained nonlinear dynamical systems
results.abstract: Filters a nominal learning-based control input through a predictive constrained backup plan into a terminal safe set, with uncertainty bounds and an explicit recursively feasible fallback construction.

results.title: A General Safety Framework for Learning-Based Control in Uncertain Robotic Systems
results.abstract: Uses Hamilton-Jacobi reachability and online confidence monitoring to apply a least-restrictive safety action only when the nominal controller can no longer be guaranteed safe.

results.title: Control Barrier Function Based Quadratic Programs for Safety Critical Systems
results.abstract: Combines control-Lyapunov performance objectives, control-barrier safety conditions and actuator bounds in a real-time quadratic program whose output is the applied control action.

results.title: Feasibility-Aware Decision-Focused Learning for Predicting Parameters in the Constraints
results.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38
results.abstract: Learns uncertain constraint parameters using losses that explicitly trade downstream infeasibility against suboptimality, rather than treating constraint prediction accuracy as the objective.
